exposure: Management strategies for Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS)
Use of transvaginal sonography as an adjuvant diagnostic tool
Management of vascular injuries by vascular surgeons
Involvement of gynecologic oncologists in the surgical team
Routine insertion of a central venous cannula
Type of abdominal incision (median abdominal incision)
outcome: Differences and consensus points in PAS management
Prevalence of specific management practices and techniques
Consensus levels among surveyed centers regarding PAS management
cohort: Healthcare professionals/centers involved in managing Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) from 37 tertiary centers across Turkey who responded to an online survey.
finding: The study identified several areas of consensus or strong consensus regarding diagnostic tools (e.g., frequent use of transvaginal sonography), surgical approaches (e.g., median abdominal incision, total hysterectomy), intraoperative management (e.g., general anesthesia, no routine hypogastric artery ligation), and postoperative care (e.g., early mobilization, oral intake, 3rd-4th day discharge) for PAS in Turkish tertiary centers, while also highlighting the frequent neglect of psychiatric needs.
cross-section timing: Practices reported at the time of the survey (implied 2024)
